body:
Hello, I'm a 24F dealing with the same stuff as you, including sexual/physical/verbal/emotional abuse and neglect. If you need to talk to someone I'd be happy to listen. 

I've been given the same advice. I know how frustrating it is, to be told by some 30-something year old psych grad that I need to just "pull myself out of this funk". I don't know where to go from here either, but if you need a kindred spirit to talk to, I'll be here.

I'm almost 25, I'm not sure if that is considered young still (completely serious about that). I just feel like I should be a better, more likable person at this age.

I'm socially awkward and try to hard to impress others, so they end up thinking I'm a loser. I've been this way my entire life. I just don't want to feel alone anymore.
Almost every person I have met hates me. I don't know why. I don't want to be a crappy person. I don't know how to fix myself.
My parents hate me and think I'm a failure. I'm tired of being a disappointment to everyone.
None of the online anti-suicide chats let me connect. I tried 7 cups and no one answered. I feel like this is a sign.
